component.name: PDF Handler
component.summary: Merge, split, organize, compress and protect PDFs

description.p: A fast, private PDF toolkit that works entirely on your computer. Reorder, rotate and delete pages, merge and split documents, compress files, add or remove passwords, edit document properties, and convert between PDFs and images. Every result is verified before it is written, and originals are never modified unless you choose to overwrite them.
